name: SCADE
aliases: Space Carving with Ambiguity-Aware Depth Estimates
definition: A NeRF reconstruction approach that regularizes optimization with multimodal depth estimates from an ambiguity-aware prior, resolving ambiguities via a space carving loss that fuses estimates across views to achieve globally consistent 3D reconstruction.
summary: SCADE is a NeRF reconstruction method that uses multimodal depth estimates and a space carving loss to resolve ambiguities and clear dust, outperforming unimodal priors.
